body.statement: For every \(I\in\mathfrak J_{q,k}\), exact substitution of the observational component kernels for every intervention-untouched original block produces an equivalent canonical program. If the intervention touches exactly one original block, the reduced objective is linear and reproduces the one-component linear program of Shridharan--Iyengar. If it touches exactly two original blocks, the reduced objective is block-bilinear, hence quadratic after scalar expansion, and reproduces their two-component quadratic program. The headline domain is exactly \(\mathfrak I_{q,k}^{\ge3}=\{I\in\mathfrak J_{q,k}:a\text{ touches at least three blocks in }C\}\).
body.justification: The superclass makes the required one- and two-component sanity reductions well-typed without weakening the headline three-component domain.
body.gap: Shridharan--Iyengar supply the low-degree programs, while the missing formal point here is their exact restriction relation to the cardinality-unrestricted serialized superclass.
body.consumer: A frontend can dispatch one- and two-component inputs to the published low-degree path and reserve the certified-width path for the headline subcase.
